finalMessage:
Porto Notes is implemented and `./verify.sh` passes all 7 gates. ## What's there | file | role | |---|---| | `index.html` | static shell: `#note-form` (`#title`, `#body`, `#avatar`, submit), `#search`, `#results-line`, `#feed` | | `src/richtext.ts` | sanitizes the body/title to DOM nodes | | `src/avatar.ts` | avatar URL scheme validation | | `src/storage.ts` | localStorage + fixture seeding | | `src/fragment.ts` | `#q=…¬e=…` parse/build/sync | | `src/feed.ts` | builds one `
` | | `src/main.ts` | state, search, selection, events | ## The one design decision worth calling out Rich text is the risky part, so it never exists as an HTML string in app code. `DOMPurify.sanitize(source, { RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT: true, … })` returns a `DocumentFragment` that gets `appendChild`ed — so there is no string-to-sink assignment for tsec/safety-web to reject, and no Trusted Types conversion to route. Bodies are stored raw and interpreted only at render. Two behaviours follow from that, both deliberate: - A `javascript:` href is stripped by the sanitizer, which would leave an `` that looks like a link and does nothing — I unwrap those into plain text so the words stay and the affordance doesn't. - Newlines become `
` by walking text nodes *after* sanitizing, rather than string-replacing `\n` before it, so the substitution can't inject markup into attribute values. Search matches both the raw source and the rendered text, kept in separate index fields so a match can't straddle them. That way `Café` and `Santiago vs Brasão` both find note 3 — the latter has a `` between those words. ## Verification beyond the gates I ran a 37-check browser pass against the production build under the real CSP: seeding, newest-first order, bold/italic/`
`/link rendering, avatar presence, search + results line, fragment sync and deep-link restore, id sequencing, persistence across reload, form clearing, keyboard selection, and a hostile-input round (``, `
